verdict.rationale: Productboard publishes extensive REST API documentation (docs-1–docs-20) but no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec exists; direct probes for openapi.json, swagger.json, and other standard spec paths all returned 404 (productboard-probe-2). The llms.txt file found (productboard-probe-1) is a docs-index for LLMs, not a machine-readable API spec.
